<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>BFL 5-Round Fantasy Draft</title>
    <!-- Tailwind CSS CDN -->
    <script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
    <!-- FontAwesome for Icons -->
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/6.4.0/css/all.min.css">
    <!-- Inter Font -->
    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700;800;900&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
    <script>
        tailwind.config = {
            darkMode: 'class',
            theme: {
                extend: {
                    colors: {
                        brand: {
                            50: '#eef2ff',
                            100: '#e0e7ff',
                            500: '#6366f1',
                            600: '#4f46e5',
                            700: '#4338ca',
                            900: '#312e81',
                        },
                        bfl: {
                            gold: '#f59e0b',
                            dark: '#0f172a',
                            card: '#1e293b',
                            border: '#334155',
                            accent: '#10b981'
                        }
                    },
                    fontFamily: {
                        sans: ['Inter', 'sans-serif'],
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    </script>
    <style>
        /* Custom Animations & Styles */
        @keyframes pulseGlow {
            0%, 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.4); }
            50% { box-shadow: 0 0 25px rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.8); }
        }
        .pulse-glow {
            animation: pulseGlow 2s infinite;
        }
        @keyframes revealPts {
            0% { transform: scale(0.5); opacity: 0; }
            70% { transform: scale(1.2); }
            100% { transform: scale(1); opacity: 1; }
        }
        .animate-reveal {
            animation: revealPts 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.175, 0.885, 0.32, 1.275) forwards;
        }
        /* Glassmorphism elements */
        .glass-panel {
            background: rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.75);
            backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
        }
        /* Custom Scrollbar */
        ::-webkit-scrollbar {
            width: 8px;
            height: 8px;
        }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
            background: #0f172a;
        }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
            background: #334155;
            border-radius: 4px;
        }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
            background: #475569;
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body class="bg-slate-950 text-slate-100 font-sans min-h-screen flex flex-col selection:bg-indigo-500 selection:text-white">

    <header class="border-b border-slate-800 bg-slate-900/80 sticky top-0 z-30 backdrop-blur-md">
        <div class="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 h-16 flex items-center justify-between">
            <!-- Logo -->
            <div class="flex items-center space-x-3">
                <div class="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-tr from-indigo-600 to-amber-500 flex items-center justify-center font-black text-xl text-white shadow-lg shadow-indigo-500/30">
                    BFL
                </div>
                <div>
                    <h1 class="font-black text-lg sm:text-xl tracking-tight bg-gradient-to-r from-white via-slate-200 to-slate-400 bg-clip-text text-transparent">
                        BFL DRAFT SIMULATOR
                    </h1>
                    <p class="text-xs text-amber-400 font-semibold tracking-wider uppercase">Official 5-Round League Draft</p>
                </div>
            </div>

            <!-- Action Controls -->
            <div class="flex items-center space-x-2 sm:space-x-3">
                <button id="adminBtn" onclick="toggleAdminModal(true)" class="px-3 py-2 sm:px-4 sm:py-2 rounded-lg bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-200 text-xs sm:text-sm font-semibold transition border border-slate-700 flex items-center space-x-2">
                    <i class="fa-solid fa-user-gear text-indigo-400"></i>
                    <span class="hidden sm:inline">Commissioner Panel</span>
                    <span class="sm:hidden">Admin</span>
                </button>

                <button id="resetDraftBtn" onclick="restartDraft()" class="px-3 py-2 sm:px-4 sm:py-2 rounded-lg bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 text-white text-xs sm:text-sm font-semibold transition shadow-md shadow-indigo-600/30 flex items-center space-x-2">
                    <i class="fa-solid fa-rotate-right"></i>
                    <span>New Draft</span>
                </button>
            </div>
        </div>
    </header>

    <main class="flex-grow max-w-7xl w-full mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-6 flex flex-col gap-6">

        <!-- Top Banner: Draft Progress & Current Randomized Team -->
        <section class="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
            
            <!-- Round Tracker Card -->
            <div class="glass-panel p-5 rounded-2xl flex flex-col justify-between relative overflow-hidden">
                <div class="absolute -right-6 -top-6 w-24 h-24 bg-indigo-500/10 rounded-full blur-xl pointer-events-none"></div>
                <div class="flex justify-between items-start mb-2">
                    <span class="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400">Draft Status</span>
                    <span id="roundBadge" class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-bold bg-indigo-500/20 text-indigo-300 border border-indigo-500/30">
                        ROUND 1 OF 5
                    </span>
                </div>
                <!-- Visual Progress Bar -->
                <div class="my-3">
                    <div class="flex justify-between text-xs font-semibold text-slate-400 mb-1.5">
                        <span>Pick <span id="currentPickNum">1</span>/5</span>
                        <span id="progressPercent">20%</span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="w-full h-2.5 bg-slate-800 rounded-full overflow-hidden p-0.5 border border-slate-700/50">
                        <div id="progressBar" class="h-full bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-500 to-amber-500 rounded-full transition-all duration-500 w-1/5"></div>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <p class="text-xs text-slate-400">Team switches automatically after every pick!</p>
            </div>

            <!-- Randomized Active BFL Team Card -->
            <div class="glass-panel p-5 rounded-2xl lg:col-span-2 border-l-4 border-l-amber-500 flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-4 relative overflow-hidden">
                <div class="flex items-center space-x-4 w-full sm:w-auto">
                    <!-- Updated container for high-resolution team SVG logo -->
                    <div id="teamLogoContainer" class="w-16 h-16 sm:w-20 sm:h-20 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-br from-slate-800 to-slate-900 border border-slate-700 flex items-center justify-center text-amber-400 shrink-0 shadow-inner p-2">
                        <!-- SVG Logo Injected Dynamically -->
                    </div>
                    <div>
                        <div class="flex items-center space-x-2">
                            <span class="inline-block w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-400 animate-ping"></span>
                            <span class="text-xs font-extrabold uppercase tracking-widest text-emerald-400">On The Clock</span>
                        </div>
                        <h2 id="activeTeamName" class="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black text-white tracking-tight">
                            Loading Team...
                        </h2>
                        <p id="activeTeamSubtext" class="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-0.5">
                            You can ONLY draft players from this randomized BFL team during this pick.
                        </p>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div class="w-full sm:w-auto flex sm:flex-col items-center sm:items-end justify-between border-t sm:border-t-0 border-slate-800 pt-3 sm:pt-0">
                    <span class="text-xs text-slate-400 font-medium">Available Pool</span>
                    <span id="teamPlayerCount" class="text-lg font-bold text-amber-400">0 Eligible Players</span>
                </div>
            </div>
        </section>

        <section class="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6">

            <!-- Left 7 Cols: Available Players Pool from Current Team -->
            <div class="lg:col-span-7 flex flex-col gap-4">
                <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <h3 class="text-lg font-bold text-white flex items-center gap-2">
                        <i class="fa-solid fa-users text-indigo-400"></i>
                        Available Team Players
                    </h3>
                    <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <!-- Filter Tabs -->
                        <div class="bg-slate-900 p-1 rounded-lg border border-slate-800 flex text-xs font-medium">
                            <button onclick="filterPosition('ALL')" id="filterBtn-ALL" class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md bg-indigo-600 text-white transition">ALL</button>
                            <button onclick="filterPosition('QB')" id="filterBtn-QB" class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md text-slate-400 hover:text-white transition">QB</button>
                            <button onclick="filterPosition('RB')" id="filterBtn-RB" class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md text-slate-400 hover:text-white transition">RB</button>
                            <button onclick="filterPosition('WR')" id="filterBtn-WR" class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md text-slate-400 hover:text-white transition">WR</button>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <!-- Player Cards Container -->
                <div id="playerList" class="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3 min-h-[320px]">
                    <!-- JS Injected Player Cards -->
                </div>
            </div>

            <!-- Right 5 Cols: User Lineup Dashboard -->
            <div class="lg:col-span-5 flex flex-col gap-4">
                <div class="glass-panel p-5 rounded-2xl border border-slate-800 flex flex-col h-full justify-between">
                    <div>
                        <!-- Lineup Header with Running Total Score -->
                        <div class="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-800 pb-4 mb-4">
                            <div>
                                <h3 class="text-lg font-black text-white uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-2">
                                    <i class="fa-solid fa-trophy text-amber-400"></i> My Lineup
                                </h3>
                                <p class="text-xs text-slate-400">5 Required Draft Slots</p>
                            </div>
                            <div class="text-right">
                                <span class="text-xs text-slate-400 uppercase font-bold tracking-wider block">Total Points</span>
                                <span id="totalLineupPoints" class="text-2xl font-black text-emerald-400 tracking-tight">0.0</span>
                            </div>
                        </div>

                        <!-- 5 Roster Slot Cards -->
                        <div class="space-y-2.5" id="rosterSlotsContainer">
                            <!-- QB Slot -->
                            <div id="slot-QB" class="p-3 rounded-xl bg-slate-900/80 border border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between transition-all">
                                <div class="flex items-center space-x-3">
                                    <span class="w-10 h-10 rounded-lg bg-indigo-950 text-indigo-400 border border-indigo-800/50 flex items-center justify-center font-black text-xs">QB</span>
                                    <div>
                                        <div class="text-xs font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider">Quarterback</div>
                                        <div class="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-500 italic slot-player-name">Empty Slot</div>
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                                <div class="text-right slot-points-container hidden">
                                    <span class="text-xs text-slate-400 block">Fantasy Pts</span>
                                    <span class="text-base font-extrabold text-emerald-400 slot-pts">0.0</span>
                                </div>
                            </div>

                            <!-- RB Slot -->
                            <div id="slot-RB" class="p-3 rounded-xl bg-slate-900/80 border border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between transition-all">
                                <div class="flex items-center space-x-3">
                                    <span class="w-10 h-10 rounded-lg bg-emerald-950 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-800/50 flex items-center justify-center font-black text-xs">RB</span>
                                    <div>
                                        <div class="text-xs font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider">Running Back</div>
                                        <div class="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-500 italic slot-player-name">Empty Slot</div>
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                                <div class="text-right slot-points-container hidden">
                                    <span class="text-xs text-slate-400 block">Fantasy Pts</span>
                                    <span class="text-base font-extrabold text-emerald-400 slot-pts">0.0</span>
                                </div>
                            </div>

                            <!-- WR1 Slot -->
                            <div id="slot-WR1" class="p-3 rounded-xl bg-slate-900/80 border border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between transition-all">
                                <div class="flex items-center space-x-3">
                                    <span class="w-10 h-10 rounded-lg bg-amber-950 text-amber-400 border border-amber-800/50 flex items-center justify-center font-black text-xs">WR</span>
                                    <div>
                                        <div class="text-xs font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider">Wide Receiver 1</div>
                                        <div class="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-500 italic slot-player-name">Empty Slot</div>
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                                <div class="text-right slot-points-container hidden">
                                    <span class="text-xs text-slate-400 block">Fantasy Pts</span>
                                    <span class="text-base font-extrabold text-emerald-400 slot-pts">0.0</span>
                                </div>
                            </div>

                            <!-- WR2 Slot -->
                            <div id="slot-WR2" class="p-3 rounded-xl bg-slate-900/80 border border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between transition-all">
                                <div class="flex items-center space-x-3">
                                    <span class="w-10 h-10 rounded-lg bg-amber-950 text-amber-400 border border-amber-800/50 flex items-center justify-center font-black text-xs">WR</span>
                                    <div>
                                        <div class="text-xs font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider">Wide Receiver 2</div>
                                        <div class="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-500 italic slot-player-name">Empty Slot</div>
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                                <div class="text-right slot-points-container hidden">
                                    <span class="text-xs text-slate-400 block">Fantasy Pts</span>
                                    <span class="text-base font-extrabold text-emerald-400 slot-pts">0.0</span>
                                </div>
                            </div>

                            <!-- FLEX Slot -->
                            <div id="slot-FLEX" class="p-3 rounded-xl bg-slate-900/80 border border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between transition-all">
                                <div class="flex items-center space-x-3">
                                    <span class="w-10 h-10 rounded-lg bg-purple-950 text-purple-400 border border-purple-800/50 flex items-center justify-center font-black text-xs">FLX</span>
                                    <div>
                                        <div class="text-xs font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider">Flex (QB/RB/WR)</div>
                                        <div class="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-500 italic slot-player-name">Empty Slot</div>
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                                <div class="text-right slot-points-container hidden">
                                    <span class="text-xs text-slate-400 block">Fantasy Pts</span>
                                    <span class="text-base font-extrabold text-emerald-400 slot-pts">0.0</span>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    <!-- Guidance Info -->
                    <div class="mt-4 pt-3 border-t border-slate-800/80 text-xs text-slate-400 flex items-center justify-between">
                        <span>Points revealed immediately upon drafting</span>
                        <i class="fa-solid fa-circle-info text-slate-500"></i>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </section>
    </main>


    <!-- DRAFT COMPLETE RECAP MODAL -->
    <div id="completeModal" class="fixed inset-0 bg-slate-950/80 backdrop-blur-md z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 hidden">
        <div class="glass-panel max-w-lg w-full rounded-3xl p-6 sm:p-8 border border-indigo-500/30 shadow-2xl relative animate-reveal text-center">
            <div class="w-20 h-20 bg-gradient-to-tr from-amber-500 to-emerald-400 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-4 text-slate-950 text-3xl shadow-lg shadow-amber-500/20">
                <i class="fa-solid fa-trophy"></i>
            </div>
            
            <h2 class="text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-black text-white tracking-tight mb-1">DRAFT COMPLETE!</h2>
            <p class="text-slate-400 text-sm mb-6">Your 5-Round BFL Fantasy Team is Locked In</p>

            <div class="bg-slate-900/90 rounded-2xl p-4 border border-slate-800 mb-6">
                <div class="text-xs uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 mb-1">Final Team Total Score</div>
                <div id="finalTotalScore" class="text-4xl font-black text-emerald-400 tracking-tight">0.0</div>
                <div class="text-xs text-amber-400 font-semibold mt-1" id="scoreRatingText">Great Draft Strategy!</div>
            </div>

            <!-- Draft Breakdown List -->
            <div id="finalLineupList" class="space-y-2 text-left mb-6 max-h-48 overflow-y-auto pr-1">
                <!-- Injected via JS -->
            </div>

            <div class="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-3">
                <button onclick="shareResults()" class="flex-1 py-3 px-4 rounded-xl bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-200 text-sm font-bold transition border border-slate-700 flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
                    <i class="fa-solid fa-share-nodes"></i> Copy Summary
                </button>
                <button onclick="restartDraft()" class="flex-1 py-3 px-4 rounded-xl bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 text-white text-sm font-bold transition shadow-lg shadow-indigo-600/30 flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
                    <i class="fa-solid fa-play"></i> Draft Again
                </button>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- COMMISSIONER / ADMIN PANEL MODAL -->
    <div id="adminModal" class="fixed inset-0 bg-slate-950/80 backdrop-blur-md z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 hidden">
        <div class="glass-panel max-w-2xl w-full rounded-3xl p-6 sm:p-8 border border-slate-700 shadow-2xl relative max-h-[90vh] flex flex-col">
            
            <!-- Modal Header -->
            <div class="flex justify-between items-center pb-4 border-b border-slate-800">
                <div class="flex items-center space-x-3">
                    <div class="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-indigo-600/20 border border-indigo-500/30 text-indigo-400">
                        <i class="fa-solid fa-sliders text-xl"></i>
                    </div>
                    <div>
                        <h3 class="text-xl font-bold text-white">Commissioner Setup</h3>
                        <p class="text-xs text-slate-400">Manage Custom BFL Players, Pre-populate & Export Rosters</p>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <button onclick="toggleAdminModal(false)" class="text-slate-400 hover:text-white text-xl">
                    <i class="fa-solid fa-xmark"></i>
                </button>
            </div>

            <!-- Modal Content Scrollable Area -->
            <div class="overflow-y-auto my-4 pr-1 space-y-6 flex-grow">

                <!-- Quick Actions: Seed Demo Players / Reset Roster -->
                <div class="p-4 rounded-2xl bg-indigo-950/30 border border-indigo-800/40 flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-3">
                    <div>
                        <h4 class="text-sm font-bold text-indigo-200">Roster Utilities</h4>
                        <p class="text-xs text-indigo-300/70">Instantly populate custom BFL players across all 32 teams.</p>
                    </div>
                    <div class="flex items-center space-x-2 w-full sm:w-auto">
                        <button onclick="seedSampleRoster()" class="px-3 py-2 rounded-lg bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 text-white text-xs font-bold transition w-full sm:w-auto">
                            <i class="fa-solid fa-wand-magic-sparkles mr-1"></i> Auto-Fill Sample Players
                        </button>
                        <button onclick="clearCustomRoster()" class="px-3 py-2 rounded-lg bg-rose-950/50 border border-rose-800 text-rose-300 hover:bg-rose-900 text-xs font-bold transition">
                            Clear
                        </button>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <!-- Form: Add Custom Player -->
                <form id="addPlayerForm" onsubmit="handleCustomPlayerSubmit(event)" class="bg-slate-900/80 p-4 rounded-2xl border border-slate-800 space-y-4">
                    <h4 class="text-sm font-bold text-white flex items-center gap-2">
                        <i class="fa-solid fa-user-plus text-amber-400"></i>
                        Add New Custom Player
                    </h4>

                    <div class="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                        <div>
                            <label class="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-400 mb-1">Player Name</label>
                            <input type="text" id="inputPlayerName" required placeholder="e.g. Jaxson Steele" class="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-indigo-500">
                        </div>

                        <div>
                            <label class="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-400 mb-1">Position</label>
                            <select id="inputPlayerPos" required class="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-indigo-500">
                                <option value="QB">Quarterback (QB)</option>
                                <option value="RB">Running Back (RB)</option>
                                <option value="WR">Wide Receiver (WR)</option>
                            </select>
                        </div>

                        <div>
                            <label class="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-400 mb-1">BFL Team (32 Available)</label>
                            <select id="inputPlayerTeam" required class="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-indigo-500">
                                <!-- Populated dynamically -->
                            </select>
                        </div>

                        <div>
                            <label class="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-400 mb-1">Projected Fantasy Points</label>
                            <input type="number" step="0.1" id="inputPlayerPts" required placeholder="e.g. 18.5" class="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-indigo-500">
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    <button type="submit" class="w-full py-2.5 rounded-lg bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white font-bold text-sm transition">
                        <i class="fa-solid fa-plus mr-1"></i> Add Player To Team Roster
                    </button>
                </form>

                <!-- Export / Import Section -->
                <div class="bg-slate-900/80 p-4 rounded-2xl border border-slate-800 space-y-3">
                    <h4 class="text-sm font-bold text-white flex items-center gap-2">
                        <i class="fa-solid fa-file-export text-indigo-400"></i>
                        Share / Export Roster JSON
                    </h4>
                    <p class="text-xs text-slate-400">Save your custom players or load a preset file to play with friends.</p>
                    
                    <div class="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-2">
                        <button onclick="exportRosterJSON()" class="flex-1 py-2 px-3 rounded-lg bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-200 text-xs font-bold transition border border-slate-700 flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
                            <i class="fa-solid fa-download"></i> Export Roster File
                        </button>

                        <label class="flex-1 py-2 px-3 rounded-lg bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-200 text-xs font-bold transition border border-slate-700 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 cursor-pointer">
                            <i class="fa-solid fa-upload"></i> Import Roster File
                            <input type="file" id="importFileInput" accept=".json" class="hidden" onchange="importRosterJSON(event)">
                        </label>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <!-- Roster List Overview -->
                <div>
                    <div class="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
                        <h4 class="text-sm font-bold text-white">Current Custom Player Database</h4>
                        <span id="adminTotalPlayersCount" class="text-xs text-amber-400 font-semibold">0 Players Total</span>
                    </div>
                    <div id="adminPlayerList" class="max-h-48 overflow-y-auto space-y-2 bg-slate-950 p-2 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
                        <!-- JS Injected items -->
                    </div>
                </div>

            </div>

            <!-- Modal Footer -->
            <div class="pt-3 border-t border-slate-800 flex justify-end">
                <button onclick="toggleAdminModal(false)" class="px-5 py-2 rounded-xl bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-white font-bold text-sm transition">
                    Done
                </button>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <div id="adminPinModal" class="fixed inset-0 bg-slate-950/80 backdrop-blur-md z-[60] flex items-center justify-center p-4 hidden">
        <div class="glass-panel max-w-md w-full rounded-3xl p-6 sm:p-8 border border-indigo-500/30 shadow-2xl relative">
            <div class="text-center">
                <div class="mx-auto mb-4 p-4 w-16 h-16 rounded-2xl bg-indigo-600/20 border border-indigo-500/30 text-indigo-400 flex items-center justify-center">
                    <i class="fa-solid fa-lock text-2xl"></i>
                </div>
                <h3 class="text-2xl font-bold text-white">Commissioner Access</h3>
                <p class="text-sm text-slate-400 mt-2">Enter the Commissioner Admin PIN to continue.</p>
            </div>
            <div class="mt-6">
                <input id="adminPinInput" type="password" placeholder="Enter Admin PIN" autocomplete="off"
                    onkeydown="if(event.key === 'Enter') verifyAdminPin()"
                    class="w-full px-4 py-3 rounded-xl bg-slate-900/80 border border-slate-700 text-white text-center tracking-widest focus:outline-none focus:border-indigo-500">
                <p id="adminPinError" class="text-red-400 text-xs text-center mt-2 hidden">Incorrect admin PIN.</p>
            </div>
            <div class="flex gap-3 mt-5">
                <button onclick="closeAdminPin()" class="flex-1 py-3 rounded-xl bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-white font-bold transition">Cancel</button>
                <button onclick="verifyAdminPin()" class="flex-1 py-3 rounded-xl bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 text-white font-bold transition">Unlock</button>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- COMMISSIONER / ADMIN PANEL MODAL -->
    <div id="adminModal" class="fixed inset-0 bg-slate-950/80 backdrop-blur-md z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 hidden">
        <div class="glass-panel max-w-2xl w-full rounded-3xl p-6 sm:p-8 border border-slate-700 shadow-2xl relative max-h-[90vh] flex flex-col">
            
            <!-- Modal Header -->
            <div class="flex justify-between items-center pb-4 border-b border-slate-800">
                <div class="flex items-center space-x-3">
                    <div class="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-indigo-600/20 border border-indigo-500/30 text-indigo-400">
                        <i class="fa-solid fa-sliders text-xl"></i>
                    </div>
                    <div>
                        <h3 class="text-xl font-bold text-white">Commissioner Setup</h3>
                        <p class="text-xs text-slate-400">Manage Custom BFL Players, Pre-populate & Export Rosters</p>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <button onclick="toggleAdminModal(false)" class="text-slate-400 hover:text-white text-xl">
                    <i class="fa-solid fa-xmark"></i>
                </button>
            </div>

            <!-- Modal Content Scrollable Area -->
            <div class="overflow-y-auto my-4 pr-1 space-y-6 flex-grow">

                <!-- Quick Actions: Seed Demo Players / Reset Roster -->
                <div class="p-4 rounded-2xl bg-indigo-950/30 border border-indigo-800/40 flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-3">
                    <div>
                        <h4 class="text-sm font-bold text-indigo-200">Roster Utilities</h4>
                        <p class="text-xs text-indigo-300/70">Instantly populate custom BFL players across all 32 teams.</p>
                    </div>
                    <div class="flex items-center space-x-2 w-full sm:w-auto">
                        <button onclick="seedSampleRoster()" class="px-3 py-2 rounded-lg bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 text-white text-xs font-bold transition w-full sm:w-auto">
                            <i class="fa-solid fa-wand-magic-sparkles mr-1"></i> Auto-Fill Sample Players
                        </button>
                        <button onclick="clearCustomRoster()" class="px-3 py-2 rounded-lg bg-rose-950/50 border border-rose-800 text-rose-300 hover:bg-rose-900 text-xs font-bold transition">
                            Clear
                        </button>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <!-- Form: Add Custom Player -->
                <form id="addPlayerForm" onsubmit="handleCustomPlayerSubmit(event)" class="bg-slate-900/80 p-4 rounded-2xl border border-slate-800 space-y-4">
                    <h4 class="text-sm font-bold text-white flex items-center gap-2">
                        <i class="fa-solid fa-user-plus text-amber-400"></i>
                        Add New Custom Player
                    </h4>

                    <div class="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                        <div>
                            <label class="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-400 mb-1">Player Name</label>
                            <input type="text" id="inputPlayerName" required placeholder="e.g. Jaxson Steele" class="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-indigo-500">
                        </div>

                        <div>
                            <label class="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-400 mb-1">Position</label>
                            <select id="inputPlayerPos" required class="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-indigo-500">
                                <option value="QB">Quarterback (QB)</option>
                                <option value="RB">Running Back (RB)</option>
                                <option value="WR">Wide Receiver (WR)</option>
                            </select>
                        </div>

                        <div>
                            <label class="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-400 mb-1">BFL Team (32 Available)</label>
                            <select id="inputPlayerTeam" required class="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-indigo-500">
                                <!-- Populated dynamically -->
                            </select>
                        </div>

                        <div>
                            <label class="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-400 mb-1">Projected Fantasy Points</label>
                            <input type="number" step="0.1" id="inputPlayerPts" required placeholder="e.g. 18.5" class="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-indigo-500">
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    <button type="submit" class="w-full py-2.5 rounded-lg bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white font-bold text-sm transition">
                        <i class="fa-solid fa-plus mr-1"></i> Add Player To Team Roster
                    </button>
                </form>

                <!-- Export / Import Section -->
                <div class="bg-slate-900/80 p-4 rounded-2xl border border-slate-800 space-y-3">
                    <h4 class="text-sm font-bold text-white flex items-center gap-2">
                        <i class="fa-solid fa-file-export text-indigo-400"></i>
                        Share / Export Roster JSON
                    </h4>
                    <p class="text-xs text-slate-400">Save your custom players or load a preset file to play with friends.</p>
                    
                    <div class="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-2">
                        <button onclick="exportRosterJSON()" class="flex-1 py-2 px-3 rounded-lg bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-200 text-xs font-bold transition border border-slate-700 flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
                            <i class="fa-solid fa-download"></i> Export Roster File
                        </button>

                        <label class="flex-1 py-2 px-3 rounded-lg bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-200 text-xs font-bold transition border border-slate-700 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 cursor-pointer">
                            <i class="fa-solid fa-upload"></i> Import Roster File
                            <input type="file" id="importFileInput" accept=".json" class="hidden" onchange="importRosterJSON(event)">
                        </label>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <!-- Roster List Overview -->
                <div>
                    <div class="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
                        <h4 class="text-sm font-bold text-white">Current Custom Player Database</h4>
                        <span id="adminTotalPlayersCount" class="text-xs text-amber-400 font-semibold">0 Players Total</span>
                    </div>
                    <div id="adminPlayerList" class="max-h-48 overflow-y-auto space-y-2 bg-slate-950 p-2 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
                        <!-- JS Injected items -->
                    </div>
                </div>

            </div>

            <!-- Modal Footer -->
            <div class="pt-3 border-t border-slate-800 flex justify-end">
                <button onclick="toggleAdminModal(false)" class="px-5 py-2 rounded-xl bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-white font-bold text-sm transition">
                    Done
                </button>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Toast Notification Message Box -->
    <div id="toast" class="fixed bottom-5 right-5 bg-indigo-600 text-white px-4 py-3 rounded-xl shadow-2xl transition-all duration-300 transform translate-y-20 opacity-0 z-50 flex items-center space-x-3 border border-indigo-400/30">
        <i id="toastIcon" class="fa-solid fa-circle-check text-lg"></i>
        <span id="toastMsg" class="text-sm font-bold">Action Completed</span>
    </div>
